blocks.text: Fulfilling the commands of Allah Ta'ala solely for the pleasure of Allah Ta'ala.

blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالي: (بَلَي ق مَنْ اَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُ لِلّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ فَلَهُ اَجْرُهُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ ص وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُوْنَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Yes! Whoever submits himself (completely) to Allah while he is a doer of good, his (good) reward is with his Lord; there shall be no fear upon (such) people, nor shall they grieve.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَمَا تُنْفِقُوْنَ اِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ اللهِ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Do not spend (for pride), except to seek the pleasure of Allah.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَمَنْ يُرِدْ ثَوَابَ الدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِ مِنْهَا ۚ وَمَنْ يُرِدْ ثَوَابَ اْلآخِرَةِ نُؤْتِهِ مِنْهَا ؕ وَسَنَجْزِي الشَّاكِرِيْنَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Whoever (does good deeds) seeking the reward of this world (only), We shall give him of it; and whoever (does good deeds) seeking the reward of the Hereafter, We shall give him of it; and soon We shall give (good) reward to the grateful.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَمآ اَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ ۚ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلَي رَبِّ
